description: Control-systems primitives: actuator wrappers (rate-limit, saturation), feedback / delay (Z^-N) for breaking cyclic graphs into DAGs, fail-safe latches. Hosts nodes previously published under Physics.Control:*.

subPlugins.description: Actuator-side primitives. Setpoint wraps a controller output with rate-limit (slew) and saturation so the rest of the plant model never sees a non-physical command.
Cycle-breaking primitives. Feedback channel = unit-delay (Z^-N) that lets closed-loop control graphs (motor + PI + tachymeter) stay topologically DAG-valid.
Fail-safe / interlock primitives. Emergency Shutdown is a latched safety bit: trips on any trigger=true, stays latched until an operator-initiated reset.
